lines.zh: 我在任何一片水里都能游。
lines.en: I can swim in any water there is.

lines.zh: 池塘、沼泽、丛林水潭，我都去过。
lines.en: Ponds, swamps, jungle pools, I have been in all.

lines.zh: 我扁扁的身子贴着水草滑过去。
lines.en: My flat body slides along the waterweed.

lines.zh: 六条同伴跟在我后面，队形松散。
lines.en: Six companions trail behind me in loose order.

lines.zh: 我绕开荷叶的茎，从缝里穿过。
lines.en: I skirt the lily stems and slip through the gap.

lines.zh: 浅到只没过背，我照样走。
lines.en: It is barely back-deep, and I go anyway.

lines.zh: 我把鳃盖上的蓝斑朝着光。
lines.en: I turn the blue patch on my gill toward the light.

lines.zh: 我扁身钻过睡莲的根须。
lines.en: I slip my flat body through the lily roots.

lines.zh: 河湾的水慢，我游得也慢。
lines.en: The bend's water is slow, and so am I.

lines.zh: 我从一片水草跳到另一片。
lines.en: I move from one patch of weeds to the next.

lines.zh: 有青蛙让路，我从它旁边过。
lines.en: A frog gives way, and I pass beside it.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸边的树根走，避开急流。
lines.en: I follow the bank roots, avoiding the fast water.

lines.zh: 水面上有虫，我抬头又低下。
lines.en: Bugs touch the surface; I look up, then down.

lines.zh: 这条水沟浅，可我游得像在海里。
lines.en: This ditch is shallow, yet I swim as if at sea.

lines.zh: 我从倒木底下钻过去。
lines.en: I slip under the fallen log.

lines.zh: 水面上有落叶，我绕开它。
lines.en: Leaves float on the surface. I go around them.

lines.zh: 我在浅滩停一下，等同伴。
lines.en: I pause on the shallows to wait for the others.

lines.zh: 我拐进支流，水更凉了。
lines.en: I turn into a side stream. The water is cooler.

lines.zh: 我悬在水草旁边，慢慢摆鳍。
lines.en: I hover by the waterweed, fins barely moving.

lines.zh: 蓝斑在水里发暗，我不动。
lines.en: My blue patch dims in the water, and I stay still.

lines.zh: 太阳照到水底，我挪了半格。
lines.en: Sunlight reaches the bottom; I shift half a block.

lines.zh: 我鳃盖一开一合，蓝斑闪了一下。
lines.en: My gill cover opens and closes; the blue spot flashes.

lines.zh: 同伴绕着我转，我不理。
lines.en: My companions circle me, and I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我心里想着水面上的虫子。
lines.en: My mind is on the bugs at the surface.

lines.zh: 浅水里什么都不急，我也不急。
lines.en: Nothing in the shallows hurries, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥底，等水自己变暖。
lines.en: I lie on the bottom and wait for the water to warm.

lines.zh: 一只蜻蜓点在远处，我没追。
lines.en: A dragonfly touches down far off; I do not chase.

lines.zh: 我把鳍张开又收起来。
lines.en: I spread my fins and fold them again.

lines.zh: 这片水潭小，可我认得每块石头。
lines.en: This pool is small, but I know every stone.

lines.zh: 水草挡住半片天，我正好休息。
lines.en: The weeds block half the sky, which suits my rest.

lines.zh: 我数着落进水里的叶片。
lines.en: I count the leaves dropping into the water.

lines.zh: 蓝斑是我身上唯一亮的东西。
lines.en: The blue patch is the only bright thing I own.

lines.zh: 我从水草里探头，看你的手。
lines.en: I poke out of the weeds and look at your hands.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，脸离水很近。
lines.en: You crouch at the bank with your face near the water.

lines.zh: 我的蓝斑亮了一下，大概是给你看的。
lines.en: My blue patch flashes, perhaps for you.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，哪片水里都有人来。
lines.en: I do not fear people; they come to every water.

lines.zh: 你伸手指进来，我绕着它转。
lines.en: You dip a finger in, and I circle it.

lines.zh: 我看你的倒影比看你更清楚。
lines.en: I see your reflection more clearly than you.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西晃，我抬起了头。
lines.en: The thing in your hand sways and I look up.

lines.zh: 我停在你影子里，那里凉。
lines.en: I stop inside your shadow, where it is cool.

lines.zh: 你的靴子把泥沙踢进来，我躲开。
lines.en: Your boots kick silt in, and I dodge it.

lines.zh: 我先看你的眼睛，再看你的手。
lines.en: I check your eyes first, then your hands.

lines.zh: 你这一下，我的蓝斑都暗了。
lines.en: One blow and my blue patch goes dim.

lines.zh: 三点血，经不起你这样打。
lines.en: Three health cannot take hits like yours.

lines.zh: 蓝斑褪了色，我沉到泥上。
lines.en: My blue spot has faded; I sink onto the mud.

lines.zh: 我往水草里钻，血散在后面。
lines.en: I dive into the weeds, blood trailing behind.

lines.zh: 同伴都散了，只剩我一个。
lines.en: My companions scatter, and I am alone.

lines.zh: 水浅，我藏不住自己。
lines.en: The water is shallow, and I cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我疼得翻了个身，又正回来。
lines.en: Pain rolls me over, and I right myself.

lines.zh: 这一刀让我忘了该往哪游。
lines.en: The cut makes me forget which way to swim.

lines.zh: 我还活着，只是游得很慢。
lines.en: I am alive, only swimming very slowly.

lines.zh: 泥底接住了我，我伏着不动。
lines.en: The muddy bottom catches me, and I lie still.

lines.zh: 一条虫落在水面，我没忍住。
lines.en: A worm lands on the surface, and I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 你的鱼饵比水草里的东西香。
lines.en: Your bait smells better than anything in the weeds.

lines.zh: 我浮上来，鼻子先到。
lines.en: I rise up, nose first.

lines.zh: 同伴都在抢，我被挤到外圈。
lines.en: My companions crowd in, and I am pushed outside.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，水面破了个小口。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the surface breaks a little.

lines.zh: 那点红色一沉，我就跟下去。
lines.en: That bit of red sinks, and I follow it down.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转两圈，才敢咬。
lines.en: I circle it twice before daring to bite.

lines.zh: 饿的时间不长，可我还是馋。
lines.en: I have not been hungry long, yet I still want it.

lines.zh: 你手一抖，我的鳍跟着抖。
lines.en: Your hand twitches, and so do my fins.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，我就上了钩。
lines.en: One bite, and I am on the hook.

lines.zh: 你走进水里，我被推到一边。
lines.en: You wade in, and I am pushed aside.

lines.zh: 我的扁身子撞上你的小腿。
lines.en: My flat body bumps your calf.

lines.zh: 水草被撞断了，我绕开它。
lines.en: The weeds snap where I hit; I go around.

lines.zh: 六条鱼撞成一团，又散开。
lines.en: Six fish collide in a knot, then scatter.

lines.zh: 你踩到泥，水一下浑了。
lines.en: You step into mud, and the water goes cloudy.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝，只留尾巴在外。
lines.en: I squeeze into a stone crack, tail left out.

lines.zh: 同伴把我顶回原位。
lines.en: A companion nudges me back into place.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在荷叶茎上。
lines.en: I bump headfirst into a lily stem.

lines.zh: 你踢开水，我顺着浪退。
lines.en: You kick the water, and I ride the wave back.

lines.zh: 撞完我甩甩鳍，像没事一样。
lines.en: After the bump I shake my fins, as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我在浅水底清出一块圆坑。
lines.en: I clear a round pit in the shallow bottom.

lines.zh: 她游过来看，我守着那块沙。
lines.en: She swims over to look, and I guard that sand.

lines.zh: 我的蓝斑比平时更亮。
lines.en: My blue patch is brighter than usual.

lines.zh: 别的雄鱼靠近，我就撞过去。
lines.en: When another male comes near, I charge.

lines.zh: 我们围着坑转，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: We circle the pit, round and round.

lines.zh: 她把卵落在坑底，我在上面守。
lines.en: She lays eggs in the pit, and I stand guard.

lines.zh: 水草边的沙被我们搅得发白。
lines.en: The sand by the weeds is stirred pale by us.

lines.zh: 这片浅水够养一群小的。
lines.en: This shallows can raise a school of small ones.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只把鳍立起来。
lines.en: I make no sound; I raise my fins.

lines.zh: 等水暖了，坑里会全是小鱼。
lines.en: When the water warms, the pit will be full of fry.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下骨粉，马上吐了。
lines.en: I bite the bone meal and spit it out at once.

lines.zh: 那东西沉在水草里，我拱了拱。
lines.en: The thing sinks in the weeds; I root at it.

lines.zh: 我嘴小，叼不住这么大的。
lines.en: My mouth is small and cannot hold anything this big.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到石缝里藏着。
lines.en: I push it into a crack to hide.

lines.zh: 水一动，它就漂走了。
lines.en: The water moves, and it drifts away.

lines.zh: 这味道不像虫，我不碰。
lines.en: It smells nothing like a bug, so I leave it.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫了一下，它就翻了。
lines.en: I sweep it with my tail and it flips over.

lines.zh: 同伴过来抢，我先咬住。
lines.en: A companion comes to take it; I bite first.

lines.zh: 我含着它游了两格。
lines.en: I carry it two blocks in my mouth.

lines.zh: 落到水底的东西，最后都归泥。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the bottom belongs to the mud.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的水潭，我注意到了。
lines.en: You step into my pool, and I notice.

lines.zh: 我从水草后面绕出来，朝你。
lines.en: I slip out from behind the weeds, toward you.

lines.zh: 蓝斑对着你，这是我警告的样子。
lines.en: My blue patch faces you; this is my warning.

lines.zh: 这片水小，容不下我们两个。
lines.en: This water is small; it cannot hold us both.

lines.zh: 我盯上你的脚踝，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I fix on your ankle and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 你动了水，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: You stir the water, so I know where you are.

lines.zh: 六条同伴让开，我上前。
lines.en: My six companions part, and I move forward.

lines.zh: 我不大，可我不让。
lines.en: I am not big, but I do not yield.

lines.zh: 你最好退到岸上去。
lines.en: You had better back up to the bank.

lines.zh: 决定了，我就一直跟着。
lines.en: Once decided, I keep following.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边打转，水草跟着晃。
lines.en: I circle your feet, and the weeds sway along.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我跟半步。
lines.en: You take a step; I take half of one.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底，蓝斑藏在泥里。
lines.en: I hug the bottom, blue patch hidden in mud.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就停在荷叶下。
lines.en: You turn, and I stop beneath a lily pad.

lines.zh: 我不急，水潭就这么大。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the pool is only so big.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水底移动，我跟着它。
lines.en: Your shadow moves on the bottom, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 等你蹲下，我才靠近。
lines.en: I come closer only when you crouch.

lines.zh: 我在找你没注意的那一侧。
lines.en: I am looking for the side you ignore.

lines.zh: 水面很静，我的鳍几乎不动。
lines.en: The surface is still; my fins barely move.

lines.zh: 你已经站在我的圆坑边上了。
lines.en: You are already standing at the edge of my nest.

lines.zh: 我撞你的脚背，力道轻但突然。
lines.en: I butt your instep, light but sudden.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手指，甩了一下头。
lines.en: I bite your finger and twist my head.

lines.zh: 蓝斑一闪，我就冲上去了。
lines.en: My blue patch flashes, and I charge.

lines.zh: 你缩手，我追着又撞了一下。
lines.en: You pull your hand back; I chase and hit again.

lines.zh: 这点疼不算什么，我知道。
lines.en: I know this little pain means nothing to you.

lines.zh: 我从侧面顶你的靴子。
lines.en: I ram your boot from the side.

lines.zh: 你一退，水就乱了，我趁机咬。
lines.en: You retreat, the water churns, and I bite.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手指，往水草里拉。
lines.en: I clamp your fingers and pull toward the weeds.

lines.zh: 打完我退回水草里，等你再来。
lines.en: After the strike I retreat into the weeds and wait.

lines.zh: 你爬上岸，我在水里慢慢摆尾。
lines.en: You climb ashore; I wave my tail slowly in the water.

lines.zh: 我在一片随便什么水里出现。
lines.en: I appear in whatever water happens to be here.

lines.zh: 河、池、沼泽，我都能生。
lines.en: River, pond, swamp, I can be born in all.

lines.zh: 睁眼时身边有六条同伴。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, six companions are with me.

lines.zh: 我三点血，从第一刻就得小心。
lines.en: I have three health and must be careful from the start.

lines.zh: 水草里暖，我先躲进去。
lines.en: The weeds are warm; I hide in them first.

lines.zh: 这条河湾浅，正好养我这么大。
lines.en: This river bend is shallow, just right for my size.

lines.zh: 我的蓝斑一出生就有了。
lines.en: My blue patch was there from birth.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃，我认得这是白天。
lines.en: Light wavers on the surface; I know it is day.

lines.zh: 这片水没有主人，我算一个。
lines.en: This water has no owner; I count as one.

lines.zh: 我游进群里的最后一位。
lines.en: I swim in as the last of the school.

lines.zh: 火把贴近水面，我的鳍尖卷起。
lines.en: A torch nears the surface and my fin tips curl.

lines.zh: 我被舀出水，摔在岸上的草里。
lines.en: I am scooped out and dropped in the bank grass.

lines.zh: 水就在身边，我却喘不上气。
lines.en: Water is all around me, yet I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水潭掀翻，我摔进泥里。
lines.en: The blast overturns the pool and throws me into mud.

lines.zh: 箭射进水里，穿过我的侧身。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and passes through my side.

lines.zh: 紫光扫过水面，我的鳞一阵发麻。
lines.en: Violet light sweeps the surface and my scales go numb.

lines.zh: 水草里没有虫了，我饿得发软。
lines.en: No bugs are left in the weeds, and I grow weak.

lines.zh: 雷落进水潭，我整个人都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the pool and all of me lights up.

lines.zh: 水从底下漏走，我掉进空的黑暗。
lines.en: The water drains from below, and I fall into empty dark.
